_readme.title: Vayu + VIB Integrator Roadmap
_readme.source: Roadmap supplied by the user for website synchronization.
_readme.status_policy: Statuses reflect the supplied roadmap. Do not mark implementation complete without repository and test evidence.

phase_status.next: Immediate next work; not yet marked complete.
phase_status.planned: Planned; not started or not verified.
phase_status.deferred: Intentionally deferred; gated until prerequisites and direction allow it.

_readme.notes: This website roadmap describes the VIB Integrator plan. Phase 0 and Phase 1 are next. VIR is planned as an in-memory IR; --native at the initial subset stage means Integrator-mediated VIR execution, not native machine code. VYE packaging and backend dispatch/cache work are deferred.

phases.name: Baseline and subsystem ownership
phases.description: Establish a reproducible clean-build baseline, assign subsystem ownership, and define capability reporting before expanding implementation.

subphases.name: Confirm the Visual Studio Community clean baseline: Rebuild → Build → run_all.ps1; record the preconditions and reproducibility in script comments.
Codify subsystem ownership: identify which files belong to the frontend, typechecker, interpreter, VM, and VIB.
subphases.description: Output: vib::Feature enum covering all four execution routes and every language feature.

subphases.name: Encode the capability matrix in code as the single source of truth.
subphases.description: Output: static CapabilityInfo table in VIB/Integrator.cpp.

subphases.name: Curate fixtures with stable expected stdout for --run and --vm, plus stable failure messages for the four native-path flags.
subphases.description: Output: fixture and expected-output list embedded in tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

phases.name: Integrator API and CLI routing
phases.description: Centralize capability metadata and route all native-path diagnostics through the Integrator.

subphases.name: Expand VIB/Integrator.{hpp,cpp}: Feature, SupportLevel, ErrorKind, Backend, CapabilityInfo; extend CompileResult; add static queries; add dumpIR/emitRuntime as Integrator methods.
subphases.description: Output: Integrator API; compile() messages derived from the capability table.

subphases.name: Route NativeCompiler::compileAndRun, dumpIR, and writeRuntimeC messages through Integrator; remove hardcoded strings.
subphases.description: Output: NativeCompiler is a pure adapter.

subphases.name: Add --vib-status to vayuc; route the four native-path flags through Integrator.
subphases.description: Output: new CLI flag and capability-derived diagnostics.

subphases.name: Build the Phase 0/1 harness.

phases.name: VIB internal representation (VIR)
phases.description: Introduce VIR as an in-memory target IR produced by lowering and consumed by the verifier. No .vye container or cache is included in this phase.

subphases.name: Build the supported-subset VIR representation in memory, with lowering producing it and the verifier consuming it.
subphases.description: Output: VIB/Vir.{hpp,cpp} or equivalent; Feature::VIR = Supported for the supported subset; --dump-ir prints real VIR.

phases.name: Basic arithmetic and values
phases.description: Define precise value semantics and execute the first arithmetic subset through VIR.

subphases.name: Specify integer, boolean, and None semantics: overflow, conversion, division by zero, and comparison.
subphases.description: Output: semantics captured in code comments and tests; Feature::BasicArithmetic = Supported.

subphases.name: Lower integer/boolean expressions and local variables into VIR; execute through Integrator's in-memory interpreter-of-VIR, not the existing tree-walker or VM.
subphases.description: Output: curated arithmetic fixture produces correct stdout under --native through VIR. This is not native machine code; --native means Integrator-mediated execution at this stage.

subphases.name: Add a VIR verifier pass for types, arity, and control-flow well-formedness.

phases.name: String semantics and operations
phases.description: Define deterministic string behavior and lower string operations into VIR.

subphases.name: Specify UTF-8 policy, representation, equality, concatenation, length, and index bounds.
Lower string constants and operations into VIR.
subphases.description: Output: string fixtures pass under --native via Integrator-mediated execution.

phases.name: Functions and calls
phases.description: Implement calls and scopes with explicit safety rules.

subphases.name: Implement functions, parameters, return values, local scopes, direct calls, and arity/type checks in VIR.
Add recursion only after stack-frame safety is proven.

phases.name: Control flow and branch verification
phases.description: Add structured control flow and reject invalid branch structures.

subphases.name: Implement conditional branches, loops, return, break, and continue in VIR.
Validate branch targets and emit unreachable-code diagnostics in the verifier.

phases.name: Collections
phases.description: Add collections individually with explicit representation, mutation, iteration, and ownership semantics.

subphases.name: Implement list representation, indexing, mutation, iteration, and ownership in VIR.
Add map, tuple, and set, each gated by conformance tests.
subphases.description: Output: remaining collection tests pass before each feature is marked supported.

subphases.name: Implement module identity, import resolution, and dependency validation in VIR.
Build multi-file programs reproducibly from declared inputs.

phases.name: VIR robustness and runtime compatibility
phases.description: Harden malformed-input handling and define runtime compatibility in code.

subphases.name: Test malformed VIR: huge counts, invalid indices, truncated structures, malformed strings, and stack exhaustion.
Document runtime-compatibility policy in code (no .md); report it through --vib-status --json.

phases.name: Advanced language features and system APIs
phases.description: Expand the Integrator subset in independently tested feature groups.

subphases.name: Implement exceptions, classes/objects, closures, higher-order functions, generators, and pointers, each with its own tests.
subphases.description: Output: each feature flips independently in --vib-status.

subphases.name: Implement system APIs and standard-library surface relevant to the Integrator subset.
subphases.description: Output: parity with the interpreter for the supported subset.

phases.name: VYE container design and writer
phases.description: Deferred package-format work. Do not implement the writer before its gate after Phase 10.

subphases.name: Design-only .vye container specification: magic, version, section table, entry point, deterministic serialization, and compatibility policy. Code comments and API shape only; no writer.
Implement a deterministic .vye writer gated by --emit-vye <path>.
subphases.description: Output: --emit-vye writes a package; writer remains gated until after Phase 10.

phases.name: VYE reader and execution
phases.description: Deferred until package format design and writer gates are authorized.

subphases.name: Implement a strict .vye reader and verifier.
Add the vayu run <file>.vye execution verb.
subphases.description: Output: package round-trip and execution tests pass.

phases.name: Unified backend dispatch and caching
phases.description: Deferred until the current execution behavior is stabilized and the dispatch/cache scope is authorized.

subphases.name: Make Integrator the dispatch owner for Interpreter backend: --run routes through Integrator::dispatch(Backend::Interpreter, ...). Preserve behavior.
subphases.description: Output: run_all.ps1 remains green; dispatch is unified.

subphases.name: Make Integrator the dispatch owner for VM backend: --vm routes through Integrator::dispatch(Backend::VM, ...). Preserve behavior.
Adopt a content-addressed, atomic, recoverable artifact cache; ensure incremental graph output matches clean-build output.
subphases.description: Output: cache and incremental-equivalence tests pass.

phases.name: Benchmarks and performance tuning
phases.description: Measure behavior before optimizing; avoid unsupported performance claims.

subphases.name: Measure compile time, startup, steady-state execution, memory, and package size as separate metrics.
Tune performance based on measured results only.
subphases.description: Output: benchmark evidence supports each optimization claim.

phases.name: Native code generation
phases.description: Research native code generation on top of verified VIR; keep target and ABI rules in Vayu-owned code.

subphases.name: Research native code generation on top of VIR; keep target/ABI rules in Vayu-owned code and do not bundle LLD, DLLs, import libraries, or an external backend.
subphases.description: Output: native artifacts pass conformance for each supported target.

subphases.name: Report NativeCodegen = Supported only for targets proven by conformance tests.

phases.name: Vayu-owned ONNX support
phases.description: Implement an ONNX reader and tested operator subset without a Python generator.

subphases.name: Implement a Vayu-owned ONNX parser/reader with native fixtures; do not use a Python generator.
subphases.description: Output: malformed-model and numerical-correctness tests pass.

subphases.name: Implement a small operator subset first and expand through tests.

phases.name: Runtime capability reporting and self-hosting
phases.description: Expose machine-readable support status and attempt self-hosting only after the subset stabilizes.

subphases.name: Publish the supported feature/runtime-version matrix at runtime using --vib-status --json.
Start the self-hosting bootstrap loop only after the Integrator subset is stable.
